harness.note: Every row below marked measured=true used this identical harness and corpus, so the numbers are directly comparable to each other.

results.label: fp16 fine-tuned on WikiText+Alpaca blend (no KD)
results.config: --wikitext-frac 0.5 --distill-weight 0 --skip-layers self_attn mlp (0 layers wrapped: no quantization)
results.role: FAIR CEILING. The correct comparison point for the QAT runs: same data, same steps, same optimizer, no quantization.

results.label: fp16 fine-tuned on blend, CAKLD weight 0.5
results.role: Literal 'same everything but no quantization'. Worse than kd0 because the teacher is initially identical to the student, so the CAKLD term is a pure anchor toward base that opposes domain adaptation. kd0 is the stronger, fairer ceiling.

results.label: fp16 base model, no fine-tuning
results.role: Unadapted baseline. NOT a fair ceiling for the QAT runs -- it has had no exposure to WikiText-2 train text, so comparing QAT against it overstates quantization quality.

results.label: QAT Q2_K, ptq_q2k init, WikiText+Alpaca blend, 9 skip-layers
results.format: GGUF Q2_K (187 Q2_K / 9 F16 skip / 114 copied)

results.label: QAT Q2_K, ptq_q2k init, Alpaca only, 9 skip-layers
results.format: GGUF Q2_K (187 Q2_K / 9 F16 skip / 114 copied)
results.role: ABLATION: isolates the WikiText blend. Its training-time proxy perplexity bottomed near step 400 and then rose, i.e. it overfits Alpaca while WikiText degrades.

results.label: PTQ Q2_K (llama-quantize on the unmodified base model)
results.role: Naive 2-bit baseline, and a cross-box control: reproduces the ~276 previously reported on other hardware, which is what makes the 104.78 comparison below trustworthy.

results.label: Prior CAKLD best (reference, NOT re-measured here)
results.config: CAKLD, roundtrip init, Alpaca only, 8 skip-layers; reported in commit 305836c
results.role: Historical reference carried over from commit 305836c. Quoted, not reproduced on this box. Its exact flags are not recorded in the repo; distill-weight 0.5 is from operator recollection, not a committed config.

improvement_decomposition.note: Exact multiplicative decomposition of the 104.78 -> 26.95 improvement.

step1_ptq_q2k_init_plus_9th_skip_layer.caveat: Two changes at once (init mode AND the 9th skip-layer). Not separable without a further run.

true_cost_of_2bit.note: The honest quantization cost is QAT measured against the fp16 model trained on identical data, not against the unadapted base model.
true_cost_of_2bit.vs_unadapted_fp16_raw: 26.9519 / 21.3708 = 1.26x worse (MISLEADING -- flattered by the QAT model's domain adaptation)

analysis.size_caveat: The QAT Q2_K file is 495 MB vs PTQ's 347 MB (+43%), because 9 skip-layers and the embeddings stay F16. This is NOT an iso-size comparison, so the README's 'same 2-bit size and speed' framing does not hold for these two artifacts.
analysis.leakage_check: qat/data.py load_wikitext2_train_examples uses split='train'; the eval corpus is split='test'. No train/eval overlap.
